checkout_strategy: Independent Git repositories pinned by commit; managed by scripts/sync_tools.py

tools.name: CRISPRidentify-v2
tools.runtime: Linux x86-64; use its locked Conda/Mamba environment

tools.name: CasAndra
tools.purpose: Cas protein detection and cassette classification

tools.name: CRISPRtracrRNA-v3
tools.runtime: Linux x86-64; Python >=3.11 plus external scientific tools

tools.name: CRISPRleader-v2
tools.purpose: Source-verified CRISPR flank context extraction; leader prediction unavailable
tools.runtime: Linux; Python >=3.11; dedicated environment; no biological reference bundle

tools.name: CRISPRrepeat
tools.purpose: Source-bound repeat structure and local array-context evidence; descriptive support only
tools.runtime: Linux; Python >=3.10; isolated ViennaRNA==2.7.0 Python binding

tools.name: CRISPRspacer
tools.purpose: Offline target-to-spacer exact search and spacer-to-viral-reference BLAST search
tools.runtime: Python >=3.10; pinned BLAST+ from the tracrRNA runtime; immutable operator-provisioned references

tools.name: CRISPRmap-v2
tools.purpose: Offline prokaryotic repeat reference mapping with historical annotation evidence; standalone CLI
tools.runtime: Python >=3.10; isolated standard-library-only runtime; explicit operator-provisioned references

tools.name: RepeatTyper
tools.purpose: Offline repeat subtype inference with preserved closed-set model evidence
tools.runtime: Python >=3.11; isolated CPU-only XGBoost environment; immutable bundled 37-label model

tools.name: SpacePHARER
tools.purpose: Offline explicit spacer-group associations with combined native protein/nucleotide evidence and empirical target/control calibration
tools.runtime: Python >=3.11; isolated C++17 native engine and vendored MMseqs; operator-provisioned immutable broad phage reference

tools.name: CCTK
tools.purpose: Observed ordered spacer comparisons and sharing networks with explicit sequence identity and retained occurrence provenance
tools.runtime: Linux; Python >=3.11; isolated locked CPU environment; offline comparison without external databases

tools.name: clinker-v2
tools.purpose: Protein-neighborhood comparison from source-verified CDS features
tools.runtime: Python3.12; isolated pinned scientific Python runtime

tools.name: ISEScan-v2
tools.runtime: Linux x86-64; Python3.11; FGS1.32,HMMER3.4,BLAST2.16.0; exact bundled models

tools.name: DefenseFinder-v2
tools.purpose: Offline HMM/system-rule defense repertoire with source-bound CDS evidence

tools.name: RNAalifold-v2
tools.purpose: Homologous RNA-family alignment and comparative consensus folding with explicit source and diversity limits
tools.runtime: Python3.12; isolated ViennaRNA2.7.0 Python binding and MAFFT core7.526

tools.name: Phigaro-v2
tools.purpose: Offline source-bound prophage regions and exact same-record spacer context
tools.runtime: Python3.12; isolated Prodigal2.6.3,HMMER3.4 and exact offline pVOG profiles
